description: Use this when the user wants to find USGS river or stream gauges (site numbers) by US state and river name, or near a US city or town. Returns up to 25 active gauges with current data, with distance for city searches. Does not accept coordinates and does not return readings; use get_river_conditions for flow and gage height.

name.description: Words from the river or gauge name, e.g. Arkansas River. Optional filter.

place.description: US city or town with 15,000+ people, e.g. Boulder. Gauges are listed by distance from it.

radius_miles.description: Search radius around place in miles, 1 to 50, e.g. 15 (default 15).

state.description: US state as a two-letter code or name, e.g. CO. Required unless place is given; with place it picks between same-named cities.

name: find_river_gauges
title: Find river gauges
